# Text

Text content with an optional Argo typography role and semantic tone.

## Props

| Prop | Requirement | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | Required | string | The text displayed by the part. |
| `variant` | Optional | `title`, `heading`, `body`, `secondary`, `secondary-code`, `control`, `badge`, `code`, `nav-title`, `nav-action`, `row`, `row-detail` | The Argo typography role. |
| `tone` | Optional | `neutral`, `muted`, `accent`, `info`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `done` | The Argo semantic text tone. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | Optional | string | Optional spoken label; defaults to label. |

## Slots

This part has no named Slots.

Does not accept child nodes on the wire.
Plugin JSX also accepts text-only children in place of `label`; the worker normalizes them to the wire `label` prop.

## Accessibility

- **Accessible name:** The required `label` is the content. Optional `accessibilityLabel` overrides the spoken label.
- **Keyboard:** Text is not focusable and adds no keyboard shortcut.
- **VoiceOver:** Reads `accessibilityLabel` when set; otherwise reads `label`.
- **TalkBack:** Reads `accessibilityLabel` when set; otherwise reads `label`.

## Appearance

- **Dark mode and color:** This schema does not declare a `color` prop; use the part’s documented semantic tokens.
- **Images:** This part does not declare a direct Image prop. Image Slots use the Image part’s source and appearance rules.
